phase: Phase 6 - Protocol Assertions and Negative-Path Verification

coarse_range_fail.description: All M values return HIGH, no boundary found

backoff_underflow.description: Boundary at M0, cannot backoff by 2

fine_range_fail.description: Coarse boundary found, all fine values return HIGH

guard_not_low_high.description: Guard probe returns HIGH instead of LOW

assertions.single_bit_change: PASS - Config updates change at most 1 thermometer bit
assertions.config_change_during_reset: PASS - M/F changes only when reset asserted
assertions.config_change_during_sclk_low: PASS - M/F changes only when S_CLK low
assertions.thermometer_validity: PASS - All thermometer codes are valid (contiguous)
assertions.done_fail_exclusive: PASS - cal_done and cal_fail mutually exclusive
assertions.no_config_after_done: PASS - No configuration changes after completion

notes.hold_failure_scenarios: Deferred to transistor-level verification. Hold failures require the model to track probe count per configuration (same config probed twice returns different Q). Simple behavioral model cannot simulate this.
notes.ambiguous_scenarios: Deferred to transistor-level verification. Requires non-deterministic sensor responses.
